messages:
deploy-bot: Started CONFIG-ONLY deploy for inference-service (config v2026-11-03-7). Canary: 3 pods in us-west-2, change-window 23:00-02:00 UTC. Notes: modifying timeouts, per-route concurrency limits, and routing weights.

sophie.k: quick heads-up — we need to pin routing to avoid sending traffic to the experimental quantized-8bit variant for this canary. last time we saw tail p99 blips when mixed.

mike.r: agreed. +1 on pin. also plan to reduce max_batch_tokens and lower per-request concurrency for the canary.

jordan: what numbers are we thinking? current defaults: request_timeout_ms=3000, max_batch_tokens=2048, route_concurrency=20.

raj: propose request_timeout_ms=6000 for canary, max_batch_tokens=1024, route_concurrency=4, and canary_weight=0.01 (1%). keeps surface small for safety.

sophie.k: sounds reasonable. canary weight 1% with 3 pods is fine. confirm rollback window 30m after rollout completes?

mike.r: yes 30m, but we should have automatic rollback on error-rate >0.5% or p95 latency +50% over baseline. add a traffic-cutover ramp schedule: 1% -> 5% over 15m -> hold 15m.

jordan: adding a short circuit for routing: pin inference-service.main -> model-family:stable (no-quantize). config snippet I'm about to push: 

```yaml
routingPolicy:
  pin_to_model_family: stable
  fallback: nearest-region
  weight_ramps:
    - start: 0.01
      after: 0m
      to: 0.05
      duration: 15m
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 1024
  max_batch_size: 256
  kv_cache: enabled
timeouts:
  request_timeout_ms: 6000
  streaming_idle_ms: 500
concurrency:
  per_route: 4
  global_soft_limit: 500
```

mike.r: LGTM. make sure we also lower the per-user rate-limit in the canary to avoid noisy tenants skewing metrics. set tenant_qps_limit=5 for the canary group.

sophie.k: will coordinate with metrics to add quick grafana panel: p50/p95/p99 + error rate + CPU/GPU utilization. add a synthetic canary prompt (small seq len 64) to run every 10s.

oncall-bot: Scheduled follow-up alert: canary-health-check @ 5m, 15m, 30m. Alert thresholds: p95 > baseline*1.5 OR error_rate > 0.005 => #eng-oncall.

deploy-bot: Applying config patch now to inference-service (canary target: us-west-2). Patch id: cfg-a9f3. Dry-run passed.

mike.r: watching logs. if we see rate-limit or batching backpressure logs like `batching: shard_full` then revert batching to 2048.

jordan: initial metrics: p95 increased from 420ms -> 620ms in the first 3m of canary, but error_rate stable at 0.12%. CPU on canary pods ~ 68%. GPU mem stable.

sophie.k: acceptable so far. hold ramp to 5% until 15m check.

oncall-bot: Canary 15m check: p95 630ms, p99 1.4s, error_rate 0.14%. No automatic rollback triggered.

mike.r: still within thresholds. proceed to 5% after putting tenant_qps_limit + throttles in place (done).

jordan: updated routing table to 5% in prod.

raj: post-rollout note — we should keep this config pinned for 24h, then evaluate removing the pin if metrics stable and no regressions found in eval set.

sophie.k: agree. create a follow-up ticket for model-onboarding to test quantized-8bit family under the new batching so we can consider unpinning.

deploy-bot: CONFIG APPLY SUCCESS for cfg-a9f3. Canary completed ramp to 5%. Recording deployment metadata: canary_pods=3, final_weight=0.05, config_checksum=sha256:3b2f...

mike.r: nice. I'll monitor overnight and will escalate if anything crosses thresholds. thanks team :thumbsup:

sophie.k: TY all. keeping the pin and timeout bumps. will update the release notes with the exact config values and rollback criteria.

deploy-bot: Thread closed (no further changes)
